answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 7158 Country: India Title: My name is riyajuddin ali ahamad, is it right according to islam? Question: My name is riyajuddin ali ahamad, is it right according to islam? Answer ID: 7158 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1041/924=L/1429) As per Shariah, there is no problem is keeping the name, it is alright. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
